Louis-Dreyfus underwent treatment, including chemotherapy and a double mastectomy. In October 2018, she announced that she was cancer-free. She has since spoken openly about her experience, advocating for breast cancer awareness and research. She has also used her platform to raise funds for breast cancer charities and organizations.
